input.summary: Ported scan.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/scan.dp.cpp. The file no longer includes <dpct/dpct.hpp> or uses any dpct:: helper or DPCT_* macro. Both kernels keep the original Blelloch up-sweep/down-sweep logic and the bank-conflict offset arithmetic unchanged. Changes from the migrated output: kernels take sycl::nd_item<1> and a local_accessor scratch pointer, and use item.barrier(sycl::access::fence_space::local_space) in place of __syncthreads. The grid-stride loop uses get_group(0) and get_group_range(0). Launch is a sycl::nd_range<1> with local size N/2 and 16 * max_compute_units groups. Memory uses sycl::malloc_device with queue memcpy and sycl::free, and the queue is in-order. scan_input.hpp was already dpct-free and is unchanged. The compile without the dpct include path succeeded with 0 errors and 0 warnings. Limitation: I have no run tool, so the exact-match check against the reference (int results written as float64, atol=rtol=0) was not executed. Correctness rests on the unchanged algorithm and the clean compile.
